Name: Philip the Tetrarch
Summary: Philip the Tetrarch, a son of Herod the Great, ruled the north-eastern territories when John the Baptist began preaching. He is distinct from the apostle Philip and from Philip the Evangelist.
KeyStory: Luke names Philip among the rulers of the year the word of God came to John in the wilderness.
LifeLesson: God's story runs on a dated calendar of real rulers. Luke anchors the gospel in history, not myth.
